title: Solomon Asks for Wisdom
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who pauses and ponders, and tonight young King Solomon can ask for anything and chooses wisdom: Wren thinks a long time and puts “I wish I could be kind to everybody” in the class wish jar.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she loves to pause and ponder before she chooses. In Wren’s world today: her teacher says each child may put one wish in the class wish jar. Her friends wish for a pony, a pool and a mountain of candy. Wren thinks for a long, long time. Then, with a little help spelling, she writes, “I wish I could be kind to everybody.” Her teacher reads it out loud and smiles. Just like Solomon, who could have asked for anything, Wren learned that the best wishes are the ones that help us be better.
